answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Reaching the whisper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the vertex until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round.
